“As long as you protect Sakura, we are allies. I trust we will continue to work well together.”

Rider bows with elaborate courtesy.

“All right. Somehow or other, we'll make this work.”

“Yes. That will make Sakura happy. I will devote myself to the shadows. You must protect her wherever the sun can reach.”

Rider speaks in her quiet, measured way.

Our conversation ends there, and we return to breakfast beneath an atmosphere none of us can quite name.
